title: Before Hiring a Trainer, Try This Claude Setup
description:
Before Hiring a Trainer, Try This Claude Setup…

Most AI fitness advice is way too generic, but this Claude setup makes it a lot more personalized to YOU specifically. By creating a dedicated Claude Project and connecting it to your Apple Health and Calendar, you can have Claude analyze your real health data and daily schedule to help build smarter daily workout plans, recovery days, and routines that actually fit into your week.
